lines.en: I walk over dragging an axe.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很沉，没有喘息。
lines.en: My steps are heavy and breathless.
The air splits as I walk.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草都朝一边倒。
lines.en: The grass I pass bends one way.
No hurry; the axe drags loud.
I come down the slope with the wind.
I drift over, half an inch off the ground.
I pass a boulder, the blade scraping.
I cut through the branches in my way.
One step at a time, same direction.

lines.zh: 我的骨节在走时咔咔响。
lines.en: My joints crack as I move.

lines.zh: 我走过来时你听不到呼吸。
lines.en: You hear no breathing as I come.
I stand the axe by my feet.
I stiffen like dead wood.

lines.zh: 风在我身边绕，绕不出去。
lines.en: The wind circles me and cannot leave.
I stay still, yet the blade hums.

lines.zh: 我的脖子卡在半截姿势。
lines.en: My neck sticks at a half-turned angle.
I wait for the wind to bring a scent.
I have no breath, only cold.

lines.zh: 我松开的指骨垂在袖口。
lines.en: My loosened finger bones hang at my cuff.
I stand braced on the axe handle.
I stand still, counting the steps in the wind.
I raise my eyes, empty.

lines.zh: 我把空眼窝转过来看你。
lines.en: I turn my hollow sockets toward you.
My blade turns slightly toward you.
You are standing downwind.
I know you are alive.
There is no expression on my face.
I raise a hand and wind leaves my cuff.
I slowly set my head straight.
You smell of blood.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝对着你的方向。
lines.en: My sockets point your way.
One of my joints slips out of place.
I step back and hold.

lines.zh: 我没出声，只是慢了一拍。
lines.en: I make no sound, only slow by a beat.
A new tear opens in my rags.
I press the cut.
My axe dips.
I tilt my head and right it.
My wind falters for an instant.

lines.zh: 我的肩骨咔地错了一下。
lines.en: My shoulder bone clicks out of line.
I stare at you and remember.
I look once and do not move.
I do not eat these.
I push it aside with the axe head.
I want only what is alive.
I kick it back to you.
The wind scatters that smell.
I walk over it.
I have no appetite, only patience.

lines.zh: 那东西引不开我的注意。
lines.en: That thing can't pull my attention away.

lines.zh: 这种东西我用斧背拨开。
lines.en: I shove such things aside with the axe's flat.
You hit me like dead wood.
My shoulder knocks you aside.
The axe handle comes across to block.
Our impact throws off wind.
I am knocked back one step.
The wind makes you sway.
My bones grind against your hand.
That push of yours moves me not at all.
The grass is flattened under us.
You lose your footing; I do not.
Two undead stand in the wind.
Our blades touch.
I reach out and rest a hand on its bone.
We turn our heads together.
Our winds merge into one.
It shifts; so do I.
We stand side by side a long while.
Neither of us breathes.

lines.zh: 它的斧子靠住我的斧子。
lines.en: Its axe leans on mine.
We wait for the same gust.
I bend and snatch it up.
I flick it up with the blade.
I glance and fling it aside.
I grip until my joints creak.
I stuff it into my rags.
I lift it one-handed.
I hold it up to the wind.
My finger bones clamp tight around it.
My axe haft hooks it; I drag it along.
I take it up in my teeth.
The wind has suddenly shifted.
I raise my head, slowly.
The blade is aimed at you.
I heard something living move.
The haft turns within my palm bones.
My heel lifts off the ground first.
This distance allows one swing.
I am done standing still.
You brought the wind with you.
My joints pull taut.
Your scent is strong.
I have chosen this road.
The wind bends the grass toward you.
I slowly raise the axe.
You should not have stopped here.
My axe blade has you.
I follow you, step for step.
You turn, and I turn with you.
I stay at your flank.
My shadow drags at your heels.
You run; I speed up a little.

lines.zh: 我顺着风向把你逼出去。
lines.en: I herd you outward along the wind.
You cannot hear me breathe.
My axe scrapes along behind.
You go around a tree; I walk through.
The wind tells me where you are.
Only three blocks separate us.
When you look back I lower my head.

lines.zh: 你躲进屋里，我停在门口。
lines.en: You hide indoors; I stop at the door.
I shift forward to the beat of your steps.

lines.zh: 我的骨脚一步一步撵着。
lines.en: My bony feet tramp after you, step by step.
You retreat a block; I take two.
I am waiting for your back to hit a wall.

lines.zh: 你换了三条路，我都知道。
lines.en: You have tried three routes; I know them all.
My blade never leaves your direction.
The wind circles my arms.
I bring the axe down in a cross cut.
The wind lands first, the axe second.
The blade skims across your shoulder.
I swing the axe at your knees.

lines.zh: 反手一挑，割开你的护甲。
lines.en: A backhand rip opens your armor.
I ram you with the axe's flat.
The cut comes with a pressure of wind.
You block the handle and your hands shake.
I split a tree instead.
I chop downward.
The blade sweeps by and you fall back three blocks.
I pivot and drag out a gust.
My bone hand clamps your wrist.
The axe bites your shield's rim.
I do not ease off; I keep pressing.

lines.zh: 你听见骨节在我肩里响。
lines.en: You hear my shoulder joints crack.
I push the blade flat across.
The blow turns up the soil.
You cut me too.
I step back and prepare another cut.
The wind stops first, then I appear.

lines.zh: 坡上站着个提斧的影子。
lines.en: A shadow with an axe stands on the slope.

lines.zh: 你听见金属刮土的声音。
lines.en: You hear metal scraping soil.
There was no wind here before.
I step out from behind a dead tree.

lines.zh: 地上的草忽然朝一边倒。
lines.en: The grass suddenly bends one way.
The smell of old corpses spreads.
I slowly push up out of the soil.

lines.zh: 一个不呼吸的东西出现了。
lines.en: Something that does not breathe has appeared.

lines.zh: 我的斧刃在暗处亮了一下。
lines.en: My blade glints in the dark.
A cold wind rises behind you.
I start walking, without pause.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的破布，我照旧站着。
lines.en: Fire eats my rags; I keep standing.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，骨头散了半架。
lines.en: I fall from a height and half my frame scatters.

lines.zh: 水泡从我的空胸腔冒出来。
lines.en: Bubbles rise out of my hollow chest.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得倒退，斧子脱手。
lines.en: The blast throws me back and my axe is gone.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我肋骨之间。
lines.en: An arrow wedges between my ribs.

lines.zh: 那股力量压住了我挥斧的手。
lines.en: That force pins my swinging arm.

lines.zh: 我饿得连斧子都提不稳。
lines.en: Hunger makes my axe unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的骨头串过去。
lines.en: Lightning runs along my bones.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我一路掉下去。
lines.en: There is no ground; I fall and fall.
